portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Macro is late-cycle hawkish: Fed hiking to 3.75-4.00%, 10y at 5.27%, 30y at 5.64%, services prices index at post-2022 high, manufacturing prices up 6.8 points, Brent forecast raised to $105, yet payrolls were only +29k with -60k revisions. Breadth is narrow (RSP minus SPY -4.09% over 21 sessions, only 32% of assets positive) with leadership concentrated in semis, cyber, Taiwan and an extreme crypto outlier. Rate pressure argues against duration and small caps; energy-linked and inflation-resilient equity and high-quality cyclicals that sold off on positioning rather than fundamentals have the best reversal odds, but the FOMC on Oct 27-28, CPI on Oct 14 and the Nov 6 jobs print inside the window keep the bar for beating SPY high.

Financials ranks third on the highest quality score, a shallow prior trend break, a steeper curve and earnings season. Taiwan and Cybersecurity are supported continuations but lack pullback support and are not overreaction candidates. Duration, defensive bonds, Solar, Defense and South Africa show persistent multi-window deterioration. Ethereum's parabolic move is uninvestable on a one-month close-to-close basis.
